# Typed into product — Style Prompt

> A sentence is typed into a clean box, sent, and the answer arrives as real things: cards, a price, something already on its way. Off-white paper, one grotesk, one saturated colour, a lot of empty space, and a virtual camera that does the editing: it leans in while you type, pushes into the detail that matters, and pulls back to show the whole result. Calm, confident, current: the look of a modern software launch film, applied to anyone who answers a request.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

The film is a **conversation turned into proof**. A short request (what someone wants, a budget, a date, a question) is typed letter by letter in a rounded input card; one click sends it; the answer is shown, never described: cards stagger up, the chosen one gets a highlighter stroke and a tick, a total counts up. Between chapters a full-frame centred statement resets attention. The whole thing is **one continuous take** on a light ground, interrupted by at most one hard cut to a dark insert (the "it is already happening" moment) and back.

Native register: "you ask, it arrives". A shop or service whose work starts with a message (an order, a booking, a quote) fits; so does a creator answering a follower's question with three videos, a teacher answering a student's question with a lesson plan, or a story in which one typed message sets everything in motion.

Not a dark tech stage talk (the ground is light paper, the dark insert is short), not a screen recording (every card is drawn in HTML/CSS and stays sharp at any zoom), not a chat-bubble testimonial (no avatars talking, one request and its result), not a slideshow (shots are long; the camera moves instead of cutting).

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Ground**: warm off-white paper, full bleed, no texture, no grain, no gradient. Silence is the material: 30 % or more of the frame is empty.
- **Cards**: radius 40–48 px (at 1080 wide), a 2 px hairline a step darker than the paper, and one very soft long shadow (large blur, low opacity). Nothing has a hard outline or a bevel.
- **The input card** is the hero object: a small "to" label with a coloured square, the typed text at body-headline size, a caret in the main colour, a quiet chip on the left, a round dark send button with an up arrow on the right.
- **Pills**: fully rounded rows for steps, totals and the final call to action. The end card reuses the input card shape as a pill, so the film ends where it began.
- **Pictures** are drawn simply (CSS shapes, SVG) inside a tinted rounded square; no photos needed. With the user's own photos, crop them into the same rounded square.
- **Blur** is a transition material only: text arrives from 10–12 px blur to sharp. Never leave readable text blurred.
- **The dark insert**: near-black ground, the same pills in translucent light, one progress bar in the main colour.

## 3. Colour logic

How the brand tokens fill the roles:

| Role | Token | Use | Area |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ground | `--latar` | warm off-white paper | most of the film |
| Card | `--latar-2` | input card, answer cards, end pill | a third of the frame at most |
| Ink | `--teks` | all main type; as a ground (with `--latar` on it) the send button and the total pill | type, two small objects |
| Muted | `--teks-redup` | labels, secondary lines; hairlines are `--garis`, `--latar` with 6 % of `--teks` | small |
| Main | `--utama` | caret, the "to" square, tick badges, one emphasised word, progress fill, logo tile | tiny, except the logo tile |
| On main | `--teks-di-utama` | the ticks and the logo mark on `--utama` | tiny |
| Highlight | `--sorot`, which is `--aksen` 55 % into `--latar-2` | a marker stroke behind the one price or fact that matters; on the dark insert the italic word is `--aksen` mixed into `--teks-gelap` | once per chapter |
| Dark | `--gelap` with `--teks-gelap` | the single dark insert; fixed, the look's own | one short shot |

One saturated colour only (`--utama`); it never fills a large area except the logo tile. The highlight is always a pale tint of `--aksen`, never the raw accent, so `--teks` reads on it. Also fixed: `--bayang` (the shadow tint) and `--kue-*` (illustration colours, their tiles tinted into `--latar-2`). A brand with a dark identity turns the paper dark through `--latar`; keep the ratio: one long ground, one short contrast insert.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` carries statements, card titles, prices, the total and the name: one grotesk at 700 (Space Grotesk by default; Poppins 800 works too). Headlines tight: letter-spacing about −3 % to −4 %, line height 1.0–1.05.
- `--font-isi` carries the typed request, labels and chips at 500.
- **One serif italic word** (Playfair Display italic, the look's own face, kept whatever the brand's fonts) per statement, in `--utama` on paper or the highlight tint on the dark insert, for warmth: "Ketik *aja*.", "*langsung* diproses."
- Sizes at 1080 × 1920: statement 110–170 px; typed request 52–58 px; card titles 44–48 px; labels 32–40 px. Muted labels sit above what they label. A wider brand face needs smaller statements, never a third line.
- Statements are centred, short (2–4 words per line), sentence case. Lists, cards and typed text are left-aligned.
- Numbers in totals use tabular figures and count up.

## 5. Motion quality

- **Long shots.** The references hold a shot for about 13 s on average and cut about twice a minute. In a 15 s vertical film: one continuous light take, one hard cut to the dark insert and one back. The camera does the rest.
- **Blur-in statements**: opacity 0 → 1, blur 12 px → 0, y +18 px → 0, 0.5–0.6 s, `sine.out`; words stagger 0.14–0.16 s. Exit the same way in reverse, 0.4 s, `sine.in`.
- **Card entrances**: y +30–40 px → 0 with fade, 0.35–0.45 s, `power2.out`, stagger 0.12 s. The input card rises bigger (y +60, scale 0.96 → 1) on `expo.out`, 0.6 s.
- **Typewriter**: 0.03–0.04 s per character, linear, caret blinking at 1 Hz with a step ease. Keep the request under ~60 characters (about 2 s).
- **Click**: the cursor travels 0.5–0.6 s on `power2.out`, presses (scale 0.86, 0.12 s yoyo) together with the button, and the camera answers with a short micro push.
- **Camera numbers** (measured): micro pushes ×1.05–1.06 over ~0.3 s (on a click or a beat), or the same ×1.05 stretched across a whole chapter as a slow lean; focus push-ins ×1.4–1.5 over ~0.6 s on `sine.inOut` or `sine.out`; pull-outs to ×0.8–0.95 over ~0.5 s on `sine.inOut`, `circ.out` or linear. Scroll steps through a list are quick, ~0.25 s, `circ.out`.
- **Easing family**: `sine.out`, `circ.out`, `power1.out`, `sine.inOut`. Smooth and decelerating; no back-out bounces, no elastic. Snap only on clicks.
- What never moves: the ground. No drifting particles, no background loops; all life comes from the camera and the content.

## 6. Camera grammar

A virtual camera on a flat plane (one wrapper scaled and translated around a target point). Zoom stays ≥ ~0.8 so the edges of the plane never show.

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Slow lean-in during typing (×1.1–1.2 over the typing time) | "listen to what is being asked" | a customer's request; a follower's question; a booking |
| Micro push on the click (×1.05, 0.3 s) | the moment of commitment | send; pay; confirm; submit |
| Pull-out while the result arrives (to ×0.9–1) | the answer is bigger than the question | a set of options; a menu; a full order; a playlist |
| Focus push-in on one card (×1.4, 0.6 s, `sine.inOut`) | "this one" | the recommended product; the best price; the chosen slot; the lesson to start with |
| Highlighter stroke + tick during the hold | proof, not adjectives | a price inside the budget; "in stock"; "ready today"; "free" |
| Hard cut to the dark insert | it is already happening | baking, packing, sending; editing, rendering, uploading |
| Hard cut back to paper, slow lean on the end card | calm return, the name | logo, name, call to action |

Framing: one message per frame, centred statements, cards at about 85 % of frame width. A push-in may crop the edges of a card but never the word or number it is pushing to.

## 7. Native moves

A menu: use the ones the story needs.

- **Request → result.** A typed request is sent and immediately answered by real items. *Fits content like:* "nasi box 50 porsi hari Jumat" answered by a caterer's three packages; "video editing buat pemula" answered by a creator's three tutorials; "latihan soal pecahan kelas 5" answered by a tutor's worksheets; "kue ulang tahun 20 cm tema biru" answered by a cake shop's designs.
- **Chat bubble lift.** After sending, the input card shrinks into a bubble at the top right and the answer fills the space below. *Fits content like:* a laundry quoting "cuci setrika 5 kg" with pickup time; a creator replying to "gear apa yang kamu pakai?"; a tutor confirming a class slot; a story's first message, answered.
- **Focus push + highlighter.** The camera pushes ×1.4 into one card; a marker stroke slides under the key line; a tick pops. *Fits content like:* the hampers inside the budget; the cheapest delivery slot; the free lesson among three; the one reply that changes the story.
- **Count-up total.** A dark pill rises and the total counts up from zero. *Fits content like:* a hampers total; a laundry bill; the savings of a bundle; hours of lessons in a course.
- **Centred statement reset.** A blur-in sentence on empty paper between chapters. *Fits content like:* "Ketik aja.", "Tanpa telepon.", "Dibalas 24 jam.", "Tanya apa saja."
- **Dark insert with steps.** One hard cut to near-black: three step pills tick one by one while a progress bar fills. *Fits content like:* dipanggang → dikemas → dikirim; dicuci → disetrika → diantar; direkam → diedit → diunggah; dibaca → dikoreksi → dinilai.
- **Input card as end card.** The film closes on the same input shape as a pill, the address or chat typed into it, the send button pulsing once. *Fits content like:* a shop link; a chat number; a channel handle; "daftar kelas".

## 8. Pitfalls

- A request longer than ~60 characters makes the viewer wait for the typing: shorten it, or type at 0.03 s per character.
- Typing without a caret or without the lean-in reads as a static screenshot.
- A highlighter on everything highlights nothing: once per chapter, behind one price or fact.
- The highlight in the raw accent colour makes `--teks` unreadable on a saturated brand accent: keep `--sorot` a pale tint.
- Readable text left blurred on a hold looks like a bug: blur is for arrivals only.
- A push-in that crops the word or number it pushes to defeats the move.
- A dark insert longer than ~2.5 s turns the film into a dark film: one hard cut in, one out.
- Bouncy or elastic eases break the calm; only the click snaps.
- Anything drifting in the background (particles, loops) competes with the camera: the paper never moves.

## Measured from the references

- Films analysed: 8 (from a cluster of 167)
- Median length: 70 s (cluster median 44 s)
- Cuts per minute: median 2.0 (cluster 2.7); two films are single takes
- Median shot length: 12.9 s
- Camera moves measured: 174; most common fitted eases: `sine.out` 27, `circ.out` 26, `power1.out` 23, linear 20, `sine.inOut` 16
- Focus push-ins (zoom > ×1.15): 34, median ×1.45 over 0.61 s, eases mostly `sine.out`, `sine.inOut`, `circ.out`
- Micro pushes (≤ ×1.15): 28, median ×1.056 over 0.30 s
- Pull-outs: 57, median ×0.80 over 0.53 s
- Scroll steps: 21, median 0.24 s
- Text entrances: blur 8–12 px → 0 in 0.5–0.6 s; slide-up entrances 0.3–0.6 s with 0.08–0.15 s stagger; typewriter 0.02–0.04 s per character

# Typed into product: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.8, medium 2.6, long 3.6.

## hook

- en: a centred statement blurs in word by word on empty paper, one serif italic word in the main colour, 1.06× lean
- id: kalimat di tengah muncul dari blur per kata di kertas kosong, satu kata miring serif warna utama, kamera condong

## problem

- en: the need is typed letter by letter into the input card while the camera leans in 1.16×; one click sends it
- id: kebutuhannya diketik huruf demi huruf di kotak ketik sementara kamera mendekat 1,16×; satu klik mengirimnya

## fact

- en: a centred blur-in statement on empty paper resets attention, one serif italic word for warmth
- id: kalimat di tengah muncul dari blur di kertas kosong untuk menyegarkan perhatian, satu kata miring serif

## step

- en: hard cut to the dark insert: step pills tick one by one while a main-colour progress bar fills
- id: potong ke sisipan gelap: pil langkah dicentang satu per satu sementara bilah progres warna utama terisi

## compare

- en: answer cards stagger up; the camera pushes 1.4× into the better one, a marker slides under it, a tick pops
- id: kartu jawaban naik bertingkat; kamera mendorong 1,4× ke yang lebih baik, stabilo menyapu, centang muncul

## number

- en: a dark pill rises under the cards and the total counts up from zero in 0.8 s
- id: pil gelap naik di bawah kartu dan totalnya dihitung naik dari nol dalam 0,8 detik

## proof

- en: the camera pushes 1.4× into one card; a highlighter stroke slides under the key fact and a tick pops
- id: kamera mendorong 1,4× ke satu kartu; stabilo menyapu di bawah fakta kunci, lalu centang muncul

## offer

- en: the request shrinks to a bubble; answer cards stagger up, one is pushed into and marked, the total counts up
- id: permintaan mengecil jadi gelembung; kartu jawaban naik bertingkat, satu didorong dan distabilo, total naik

## cta

- en: hard cut back to paper: logo, name, the input card returns as a pill with the contact typed in, held 2 s
- id: potong balik ke kertas: logo, nama, kotak ketik kembali jadi pil berisi kontak yang diketik, diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: back on paper, the closing line blurs in word by word under a slow 1.05× lean, held 2 s
- id: kembali ke kertas, kalimat penutup muncul dari blur per kata, kamera condong pelan 1,05×, diam 2 detik

        box-shadow: 0 24px 60px -20px color-mix(in oklab, var(--bayang) 18%, transparent); display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 22px 0 56px; }

  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1920" data-height="1080" data-fps="30">
      <!-- Satu take terang: kamera virtual yang mengedit. -->
      <div class="layer" id="terang">

    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      const fmt = (n) => "Rp" + Math.round(n).toLocaleString("id-ID");
      // Kamera virtual: memusatkan titik (x, y) pada skala s (origin di tengah frame).
      const cam = (s, x, y) => ({ scale: s, x: -(x - 960) * s, y: -(y - 540) * s });
      // Mengetik huruf demi huruf; aman untuk seek karena teks dihitung dari progres.
      const ketik = (el, text, at, dur) => {
        const o = { n: 0 };
        tl.to(o, { n: text.length, duration: dur, ease: "none", onUpdate: () => { el.textContent = text.slice(0, Math.round(o.n)); } }, at);
      };
      const blurIn = { opacity: 0, y: 18, filter: "blur(12px)" };
      const sharp = { opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)", duration: 0.6, ease: "sine.out" };

      gsap.set("#cursor", { x: 1700, y: 1140 });
      gsap.set(["#prompt", "#judulHasil", ".produk", "#total"], { opacity: 0 });

      // 1. Pembuka (hook): kalimat blur ke tajam, kamera mendorong pelan (x1,06).
      tl.fromTo("#kecil", blurIn, sharp, 0.2)
        .fromTo("#besar span", blurIn, { ...sharp, stagger: 0.16 }, 0.55)
        .fromTo("#camA", cam(1, 960, 540), { ...cam(1.06, 960, 510), duration: 1.8, ease: "sine.out" }, 0.2)
        .to(["#kecil", "#besar"], { opacity: 0, y: -30, filter: "blur(10px)", duration: 0.4, ease: "sine.in" }, 1.95);

      // 2. Masalah (problem): kotak ketik naik, kebutuhan pelanggan diketik, kamera mendekat ke teks.
      tl.to("#camA", { ...cam(1, 960, 540), duration: 0.6, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 2.1)
        .fromTo("#prompt", { opacity: 0, y: 60, scale: 0.96 }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1, duration: 0.6, ease: "expo.out" }, 2.15)
        .fromTo("#caret", { opacity: 1 }, { opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "steps(1)", repeat: 25, yoyo: true }, 2.2)
        .to("#camA", { ...cam(1.16, 960, 470), duration: 2.2, ease: "sine.out" }, 2.6);
      ketik(document.getElementById("ketik"), "Hampers lebaran isi 3 toples, budget 300 ribu, kirim tgl 28", 2.6, 2.1);

      // Kursor menekan kirim (x1,06 cepat pada klik).
      tl.to("#cursor", { x: 1490, y: 742, duration: 0.55, ease: "power2.out" }, 4.3)
        .to("#cursor", { scale: 0.86, duration: 0.12, yoyo: true, repeat: 1, ease: "power1.inOut" }, 4.88)
        .to("#kirim", { scale: 0.88, duration: 0.12, yoyo: true, repeat: 1, ease: "power1.inOut" }, 4.88)
        .to("#camA", { ...cam(1.22, 1000, 540), duration: 0.25, ease: "circ.out" }, 4.9)
        .to("#cursor", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.25 }, 5.15)
        .set("#caret", { display: "none" }, 5.0);

      // 3. Penawaran (offer): pesan terkirim jadi gelembung di kolom kiri; kamera menarik mundur; kartu produk naik bertingkat di kanan.
      tl.to("#camA", { ...cam(1, 960, 540), duration: 0.55, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 5.15)
        .to("#prompt", { x: -730, y: -100, scale: 0.6, duration: 0.6, ease: "power2.inOut" }, 5.15)
        .fromTo("#judulHasil", { opacity: 0, y: 16 }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: "power2.out" }, 5.5)
        .fromTo(".produk", { opacity: 0, y: 40 }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: "power2.out", stagger: 0.12 }, 5.6);

      // Dorong masuk x1,4 ke pilihan kedua, stabilo dan centang.
      tl.to("#camA", { ...cam(1.4, 1260, 600), duration: 0.65, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 6.45)
        .fromTo("#stabilo", { scaleX: 0 }, { scaleX: 1, duration: 0.4, ease: "power2.out" }, 7.0)
        .fromTo("#centang", { scale: 0, opacity: 0 }, { scale: 1, opacity: 1, duration: 0.35, ease: "circ.out" }, 7.2)
        .to("#camA", { ...cam(0.96, 960, 540), duration: 0.6, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 7.7)
        .fromTo("#total", { opacity: 0, y: 40 }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.45, ease: "power2.out" }, 7.95);
      const uang = { v: 0 };
      const angka = document.getElementById("angka");
      tl.to(uang, { v: 295000, duration: 0.8, ease: "power3.out", onUpdate: () => { angka.textContent = fmt(uang.v); } }, 8.1);

      // 4. Langkah (step): potong keras ke sisipan gelap, langkah dicentang satu per satu.
      tl.set("#gelap", { visibility: "visible" }, 9.0)
        .set("#terang", { visibility: "hidden" }, 9.0)
        .fromTo("#terima span", blurIn, { ...sharp, stagger: 0.15 }, 9.05)
        .fromTo(".lk", { opacity: 0, y: 30 }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.35, ease: "power2.out", stagger: 0.12 }, 9.45)
        .fromTo(".lk i b", { scale: 0 }, { scale: 1, duration: 0.3, ease: "circ.out", stagger: 0.42 }, 9.9)
        .fromTo("#isiBar", { scaleX: 0 }, { scaleX: 1, duration: 1.3, ease: "power1.inOut" }, 9.75)
        .fromTo("#camD", cam(1, 960, 540), { ...cam(1.06, 960, 560), duration: 2.4, ease: "sine.out" }, 9.0);

      // 5. Ajakan (cta): potong balik ke terang, kotak ketik jadi ajakan, diam sampai akhir.
      tl.set("#akhir", { visibility: "visible" }, 11.4)
        .set("#gelap", { visibility: "hidden" }, 11.4)
        .fromTo("#logo", { opacity: 0, scale: 0.9, filter: "blur(12px)" }, { opacity: 1, scale: 1, filter: "blur(0px)", duration: 0.6, ease: "sine.out" }, 11.45)
        .fromTo("#nama span", blurIn, { ...sharp, stagger: 0.14 }, 11.65)
        .fromTo("#sub", blurIn, sharp, 12.0)
        .fromTo("#pill", { opacity: 0, y: 60, scale: 0.96 }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1, duration: 0.6, ease: "expo.out" }, 12.25)
        .fromTo("#caret2", { opacity: 1 }, { opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "steps(1)", repeat: 6, yoyo: true }, 12.3)
        .to("#kirim2", { scale: 0.9, duration: 0.14, yoyo: true, repeat: 1, ease: "power1.inOut" }, 13.55)
        .fromTo("#jam", { opacity: 0, y: 16 }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: "power2.out" }, 13.7)
        .fromTo("#camE", cam(1, 960, 540), { ...cam(1.05, 960, 560), duration: 3.6, ease: "sine.out" }, 11.4);
      ketik(document.getElementById("url"), "dapursekar.id", 12.7, 0.7);

      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines["main"] = tl;
    </script>
